method: Behavioural source: the extracted Matrix9 manual shipped with the milestone. QymCAD only for panel technique.

observed_symbols: gui.rs:448 comment: carry out what the properties panel asked for, after it has drawn
planned_anchors.what_is_missing: A properties panel asks and the model carries it out through one doorway: the idea OM9 keeps. QymCAD's panel writes its own state; OM9's editor goes through a document transaction so Undo owns the history.

implemented_api_before_this_task: om9-core transaction: Mutation::Attributes { source, attributes } validated against the layer's editable permission, and Mutation has no label variant
om9-app: only set_objects_hidden existed for object attributes; there was no editor table and no way to change a colour or the selectable/locked flags of an object
gap_found_by_this_task: No property editor existed at all: the panel could show nothing and edit nothing through a document command.

Added session/properties.rs: the FIELDS table (five editable attribute fields, Name and Geometry read-only with their reasons), PropertyEdit (only editable fields, so a read-only edit cannot even be expressed) and Controller::edit_object_property, which sends ONE transaction for all edited objects.

Pinned with fixtures: a colour edit is one journal entry and Undo restores the previous colour; the hidden flag follows the same rule; a no-op writes nothing; an edit on a locked layer is refused by the core and changes nothing.

RED is API-level and stated as such (the module is new). The Name field is an open item: renaming needs a document command (a Mutation::Label variant); the editor states that instead of pretending the field works.

ROUND 23: rename is implemented. `Mutation::Label { source, label }` was added to the core (variant, validation: non-empty, no padding, no control characters, at most 128 bytes; the apply bumps attributes_revision and invalidates dependents; `Mutation::source()` knows it), and `PropertyEdit::Label` drives it through the same one-transaction path. The editor's Name field is editable now; Geometry stays read-only.
reuse_decision: ADAPT the 'the panel asks, the model carries it out' idea of gui.rs; ADD the editor table and the one-transaction edit.
